<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Fill slots with bottom row pattern
# Bottom squares: R(c=10), p(c=17), N(c=24), O(c=31), M(c=38), b(c=45), Y(c=52)
# Red frame slots: id=21(c=22), id=22(c=28), id=24(c=40)
# Green frame slots: id=28(c=22), id=29(c=28), id=30(c=34), id=31(c=40)

    (10, 22, 22),   # R -> slot 21

    (38, 36, 28),   # M -> slot 29
    (45, 36, 34),   # b -> slot 30
    (52, 36, 40),   # Y -> slot 31
]

actions = []
for bc, sr, sc in fills:
    actions.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 58, 'col': bc})  # Select color

        min_r = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])

        print(f"  id={n['id']}, color={n['color']}, r={min_r}, c={min_c}")
